title: Ryan Collins, Council Member Ward 1
script:
This is the New Saint Croix Union. Wednesday's biography is Ryan Collins, Council Member Ward 1.

Ryan Collins moved to Stillwater in 2003. He holds a bachelor of science degree in history, with a minor in political science, and a master of science degree in education from the University of Wisconsin-River Falls. He teaches middle school history at Mahtomedi Middle School. He is in his twenty-sixth year there, all in the same district and the same building. He was named the 2024-25 Mahtomedi Teacher of the Year and was a semifinalist for Minnesota Teacher of the Year in 2025.

He was appointed to the Stillwater Planning Commission in December 2012. He served as its chairman for two years. He also served on the Stillwater 2040 Comprehensive Plan Advisory Committee. He has served on the board of the Washington County Historical Society, including as vice president. He is a board member of Friends of Lily Lake.

He was first elected to the Stillwater City Council in 2018, representing Ward 1. He has held the seat since January 2019. He was reelected in 2022. His current term runs through January 3, 2027. He is on the ballot again in 2026.

He has said the importance of leadership and community involvement was instilled in him at a young age by his father, who was founding president of a youth athletic association in Hastings for twenty years. He and his wife Lisa have two children, Alexis and Preston.

The pages are in the show notes.
